f.title: All UK authorised products: meet the pharmacovigilance requirements of HMR Part 11
f.statement: All UK authorised products are granted authorisations by the MHRA and must meet the pharmacovigilance requirements set out in Part 11 of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012; some additional requirements apply depending on product Category.

rows.quote: All UK authorised products are granted authorisations by the MHRA and must meet Pharmacovigilance (PV) requirements set out in Part 11 of the Human Medicines Regulations (HMR) 2012. However, some additional PV requirements apply depending on the Category of product.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; genuine duty ("must meet"), Mandatory confirmed. The page restates HMR Part 11 rather than creating a new duty. Double-check: below 90: restates HMR Part 11 (authority-only, no new duty from this page); "products ... must meet" names products, so MAH actor inferred.

f.title: Category 2 products: follow the additional EU requirements of CIR 520/2012
f.statement: Category 2 products follow the additional EU requirements in CIR 520/2012; following the recent CIR amendment, HMR Schedule 12A (domestic legislation) is no longer fully aligned with the CIR.

rows.quote: Category 2 products follow additional EU requirements set out in the CIR 520/2012. Historically, the HMR Schedule 12A has been aligned with the CIR; however, the recent CIR amendment means our domestic legislation will no longer be fully aligned.
